native_fixture_resave_scope: Apache POI producer fixture; retained as supplied

source_snapshot.scope: checked PptxRangeSource snapshots at each lifecycle boundary while the caller adapter is retained; unavailable after the caller source is dropped

provider_config.file_scope: FileSource reads a task-selected local fixture after a setup hash read; this is a warm recently-hashed filesystem baseline and carries no cold-filesystem claim
provider_config.range_scope: PptxRangeSource logical ReadAt adapter counters; caps and delay describe caller-visible calls, not physical network, filesystem, or device behavior

provider_scope: native producer PPTX selected-image lifecycle through the existing SourceBackedPresentation API; ownership and resource observations only
timing_scope: open, metadata, and image-read durations contain only their immediately surrounding public API calls; source construction, hashing, diagnostics, checks, copies, and drops are outside the clocks
file_scope: FileSource reads a task-selected local fixture after a setup hash read; this is a warm recently-hashed filesystem baseline and carries no cold-filesystem claim
range_scope: PptxRangeSource logical ReadAt adapter counters; caps and delay describe caller-visible calls, not physical network, filesystem, or device behavior
rss_scope: optional process-wide VmRSS/VmHWM snapshots from procfs; setup and unrelated process memory remain in scope and no comparative RSS claim is authorized

phases.label: baseline
phases.live_owners: fixed native archive and caller budget only; no source adapter or package owner

phases.label: opened
phases.live_owners: source-backed presentation view and caller source adapter

phases.label: selected
phases.live_owners: source-backed presentation view, selected slide handle, and caller source adapter

phases.label: loaded
phases.live_owners: source-backed presentation view, selected slide, returned image payload, and caller source adapter

phases.label: drop_view
phases.live_owners: selected slide and returned image payload retain the package owner after the public view is dropped

phases.label: drop_slide
phases.live_owners: returned image payload and its PartData remain after the selected slide handle is dropped

phases.label: drop_image
phases.live_owners: caller source adapter only after the package owner and returned image are dropped

phases.label: drop_source
phases.live_owners: no lifecycle-owned source or package owner; caller budget remains observable
